scope: Isolate the documented OpenFOAM nuTilda/nu=4 farfield value from NASA CFL3D SA's nuTilda/nu=3 value on the identical settled case.

single_change.name: farfield_nuTilda_to_nu_ratio
single_change.initialization: Copy the reconstructed settled solution to time zero; change only the farfield fixedValue and freestream reference for nuTilda. Retain the inherited internal field as restart state.

fixed.model: stock OpenFOAM v2512 SpalartAllmaras with default ft2=false

falsifiable_expectation.primary: The run reaches the existing trend, residual, and alpha-zero symmetry thresholds.
falsifiable_expectation.drag: No direction is assumed; compare the converged last-100 Cd with both the ratio-4 source and hash-pinned NASA CFL3D SA reference.
falsifiable_expectation.interpretation: This run cannot establish exact standard-SA agreement because ft2 remains false.

terminal_rule: Do not tune or extend this sensitivity. Audit it after 5000 iterations, then run a separately predeclared ft2=false-to-true test at nuTilda/nu=3.
